questions.q: At nine yesterday, everything ___ ready for the party.
questions.e: 昨天九点用过去时，everything 是单数，用 was，不能用 were。

questions.q: We didn't ___ the new policy at the meeting yesterday.
questions.e: didn't 已标出过去，后接原形 consider，不能再加 ed。

questions.q: The -ed ending in helped sounds like the -ed ending in ___.
questions.e: help 和 ask 末音是清辅音，后接 /t/。needed 多一个音节。

questions.q: Of these four words, only ___ has an -ed ending that sounds like /d/.
questions.e: love 的 /v/ 是浊音，后接 /d/。started 多一个音节。

questions.q: The -ed ending adds a syllable to both needed and ___.
questions.e: need 和 end 都以 /d/ 收尾，加 /ɪd/ 才多一个音节。

questions.q: In 'They opened the door and looked at me,' the two -ed endings are ___, in that order.
questions.e: open 末音 /n/ 后读 /d/，look 末音 /k/ 后读 /t/。

questions.q: The first way didn't work, so we ___ (try) another way.
a: tried
questions.e: 两件事都已经发生。try 以辅音加 y 结尾，先把 y 改为 i，再加 ed，写成 tried。

questions.q: The music ___ (not be) too loud at the party last night.
a: wasn't
was not
questions.e: 昨晚的情况用过去式，music 是不可数名词，用 was。直接在 was 后加 not，不能借用 didn't。

a: I loved music when I was a child.
When I was a child, I loved music.
questions.e: 两个分句都说小时候的事，用 loved 和 was。when 从句放句首也可以，后面加逗号。

questions.zh: 会议为什么提前结束了？
a: Why did the meeting end early?
Why did the meeting finish early?
questions.e: 问已经结束的会议，用 Why did 开头。did 后的 end 或 finish 用原形，不能再加 ed。

questions.a: The music stopped when she opened the door.
questions.e: 先说音乐停了，再用 when 交代时间。stop 要双写 p 再加 ed，open 直接加 ed。

questions.a: They started the meeting and talked about the new policy.
questions.e: started 的词尾读 /ɪd/，多一个音节。talked 的词尾读 /t/，不另加音节，听写时也要补上 ed。

questions.q: The class ___ ten minutes late yesterday.
questions.e: 昨天用过去式 began。begun 是过去分词，不能单独用。

questions.q: Our teacher ___ us how to use the new system last week.
questions.e: last week 用过去式。teach 变 taught，不能直接加 ed。

questions.q: The team ___ the old system when it moved to a new office.
questions.e: 搬办公室和保留系统都是过去的事，keep 变 kept，不能直接加 ed。

questions.q: Last year, it ___ ten dollars to take the bus from here to the city.
questions.e: 这里 cost 表示花多少钱，过去式拼写不变，不能写成 costed。

questions.q: I opened the door and ___ the students come in.
questions.e: 动作和 opened 并列，let 过去式不变。let's 表提议。

questions.q: After two hours of work yesterday, we ___ a break.
questions.e: take a break 表示休息一下。昨天发生的事用 took。

questions.q: The company ___ (send) the information to all of us last Friday.
a: sent
questions.e: 上周五已经过去，send 的过去式是 sent，末尾的 d 变成 t，不能写成 sended。

questions.q: I ___ (sleep) for only four hours that night, so I was tired the next morning.
a: slept
questions.e: 那晚的睡眠已经结束，sleep 的过去式是 slept。ee 变成 e，末尾加 t。

questions.zh: 他昨天把自己的书带到了办公室。
a: He brought his book to the office yesterday.
Yesterday he brought his book to the office.
questions.e: 昨天带过去用 bring 的过去式 brought。bought 是 buy 的过去式，表示买下。

questions.zh: 我们昨天午饭后去游泳了。
a: We swam after lunch yesterday.
Yesterday we swam after lunch.
questions.e: 昨天午饭后是过去时间，swim 的过去式把 i 改为 a，写成 swam。after lunch 中间不用加冠词。

questions.a: She wrote his name on a piece of paper.
questions.zh: 她把他的名字写在了一张纸上。
questions.e: 用 write 的过去式 wrote，后接写下的内容 his name。on a piece of paper 说明写在哪里。

questions.a: I went to the market and found my friend there.
questions.e: went 和 found 分别是 go 和 find 的过去式。听到 and 后也要写过去式，两件事都发生在过去。

questions.q: We made a plan yesterday. We are ___ a course at the local college next week.
questions.e: 昨天已定计划，用 are going to 加原形 take，to 不能省。

questions.q: You look tired. Sit down and I'll ___ you some water.
questions.e: 看到对方累就主动帮忙，用 I'll。will 后接原形 bring。

questions.q: Look at that glass! It ___ going to fall off the table.
questions.e: 看见迹象后作预测，用 be going to。主语 it 要配 is。

questions.q: If there ___ enough time, we'll go to the market.
questions.e: if 条件从句用现在时。time 不可数，用 is，主句才用 will。

questions.q: When the next bus ___, we'll get on it.
questions.e: when 从句用现在时表将来。bus 是单数，come 要加 s。

questions.q: We'll go home as soon as the meeting ___.
questions.e: 从句用现在时，不加 will。meeting 是单数，用 ends。

questions.q: When we ___ (reach) the city, we'll look for a place to eat.
a: reach
questions.e: 到达城市虽是将来的事，when 引导的时间从句用一般现在时。主语是 we，写 reach，不加 s 或 will。

questions.q: I ___ (will, not) tell anyone. You can tell me everything.
a: won't
will not
questions.e: 说话人在承诺保密，用 will 的否定式。缩写是 won't，不能写成 willn't，之后的 tell 用原形。

questions.zh: 我们打算这周末在家做饭。
a: We're going to cook at home this weekend.
We are going to cook at home this weekend.
This weekend, we're going to cook at home.
questions.e: 说的是已经有的打算，用 we're going to 加原形 cook。this weekend 前不用加 on。

questions.zh: 如果商店开着，我就给你买一本书。
a: If the shop is open, I'll buy you a book.
I'll buy you a book if the shop is open.
If the store is open, I will buy you a book.
questions.e: 商店开着是条件，用 if the shop is open。主句用 will 表示将来，if 从句里的 is 不改成 will be。

questions.a: As soon as the door opens, we'll go in.
questions.e: as soon as 引出时间从句，放句首时用逗号隔开。door 是单数，从句用 opens，主句用 we'll。

questions.a: I think the local team will play well next week.
questions.e: I think 引出对下周比赛的预测，用 will play。will 后不能用 plays，well 说明打得怎么样。

questions.q: The students ___ already called their parents.
questions.e: students 是复数，用 have 接过去分词 called，不能用 has。

questions.q: We ___ our art class at three yesterday.
questions.e: 昨天三点是明确的过去时间，用 started，不能用现在完成时。

questions.q: She has ___ the class, so she can take the next one now.
questions.e: 通过这门课的结果是现在能上下一门。has 后接过去分词 passed。

questions.q: We haven't had a class ___ two weeks.
questions.e: two weeks 是时长，用 for。since 后面要给出起点。

questions.q: She has worked in this field ___ she left college.
questions.e: 离开大学是起点，用 since。during 后接名词，不能接从句。

questions.q: Have your parents ___ your new home yet?
questions.e: yet 问到现在是否见过，have 后用 seen，saw 是过去式。

questions.q: Our team hasn't ___ (lose) a game this year.
a: lost
questions.e: 说今年到目前为止的战绩。hasn't 后接 lose 的过去分词 lost，这里不能留原形。

questions.q: I ___ (meet) the new teacher two days ago.
a: met
questions.e: two days ago 指两天前，用一般过去时。meet 的过去式是 met，不能用 have met。

questions.zh: 到目前为止，我们已经读了两本书。
a: So far, we've read two books.
We have read two books so far.
We've read two books so far.
questions.e: so far 统计到现在读完的书，用 have read。read 在这里是过去分词，拼写同原形，读 /red/。

questions.zh: 从去年五月起，她就是我们队的一员。
a: She has been a member of our team since last May.
She's been a member of our team since last May.
Since last May, she has been a member of our team.
questions.e: 她从去年五月到现在都是队员，用 has been。last May 是起点，前面用 since，不能用 for。

questions.a: My sister has gone to the office to get her phone.
questions.zh: 我姐姐去办公室拿手机了，还没回来。
questions.e: 姐姐去拿手机还没回来，用 has gone to the office。to get her phone 放在后面交代目的。换成 has been to 就成了去过。

questions.a: My parents have both been to Japan, so they know it well.
questions.e: 听到 both 可知两人都有这段经历，用 have both been to。have gone to 会让人理解成两人去了还没回来。

questions.q: This shop opens at nine every morning and ___ food until six.
questions.e: 说店铺每天的营业安排，用一般现在时。shop 是单数，用 sells。

questions.q: Please wait here. The teacher ___ to a student at the moment.
questions.e: 让人等是因为谈话正在进行，用 is talking。talks 表习惯。

questions.q: The bus ___ at six yesterday morning, so we were at school by seven.
questions.e: 昨天早上六点是明确的过去时间，用 left，不能用 has left。

questions.q: The school ___ the same books since last year, and it still uses them.
questions.e: 从去年持续到现在，用 has used。used 只交代过去。

questions.q: My father ___ sell books at the market, but now he works at a school.
questions.e: 以前卖书，现在换了工作。肯定句用 used to，不能漏掉 d。

questions.q: Did your family ___ to go shopping together on Sundays?
questions.e: 问过去的习惯，用 Did 加主语再接 use to。used 多标了一次过去。

questions.q: From now on, I ___ (be) on time for class. I promise.
a: will be
questions.e: from now on 指从现在起，I promise 表明是在作承诺，用 will be。will 后用原形 be，不能写成 will am。

questions.q: My sister ___ (not use) to eat breakfast. Now she eats it every morning.
a: didn't use
did not use
questions.e: 后一句说明她现在每天吃早餐，前一句说以前没有这个习惯。didn't 已标出过去，后面写 use to。

questions.zh: 我已经习惯每天写一份报告了。
a: I'm used to writing a report every day.
I am used to writing a report every day.
I'm used to writing a report each day.
questions.e: 说现在已经习惯，用 be used to 加 writing。used to write 表示以前常写，意思变了。

questions.zh: 我明天会把这份报告发给你。
a: I'll send you this report tomorrow.
I will send this report to you tomorrow.
Tomorrow I'll send you this report.
questions.e: 说的是明天要做的事，用 will send。把人放在报告前可以直接用 send you this report，换顺序时要在 you 前加 to。

questions.a: I sometimes read business books on the bus.
questions.zh: 我有时在公交车上读商务类书籍。
questions.e: sometimes 说明频率，这里放在动词 read 前。读书是平时的习惯，用一般现在时，on the bus 说明地点。

questions.a: My former teacher now works at the local college.
questions.e: former 修饰 teacher，表示以前教过我。now 说明现状，任职用一般现在时，teacher 是单数，works 要保留 s。
